title: Enoch  Dean
clean_html:
Enoch Dean

Preserved Primary Document • dean-e.htm

Enoch M. Dean was the son of Jesse Dean Jr.and Hester Ann Carney . He was born on the family farm along the Dover to Smyrna Rd. in Little Creek Hundred, Kent Co.,DE on 19 December,1833. On 30 July, 1863 he married Angelina Munce , daughter of Robert Munce Jr. and Jemima Hansor. The couple moved to Cumberland Co., NJ around 1870-74 and they appear in the census records living in Fairfield Township, Cumberland Co., NJ. They then moved to 2 Cherry Street, Bridgeton, NJ. Enoch and Angelina had the following children: Benton Dean (b.after 1866) Clara Dean (b. after 1866) Eliza Dean (b. after 1866) Elizabeth Dean (b. after 1866) Francis Dean (b. after 1866) James Dean (b. after 1866) Valerie Dean (b. after 1866) Will Dean (b. after 1866) , married Eliza Driggins Enoch Dean Jr. (b. 5 August, 1870) Irving Dean (b. 1874) married Ann Morgan Arthur M. Dean (b. 1875) Lydia A. Dean (b. 1878) Enoch died in Bridgeton, NJ on 5 January, 1914 and Angelina 3 years later on 1 February, 1917. Both are buried at the Swing Cemetary, also known as the Old Stone Church off Back Neck Rd. in Fairton, NJ.
